newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ATHLETICS-EL GUERROUJ SETS SECOND WORLD MARK.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-EL GUERROUJ SETS SECOND WORLD MARK.

text.p: Morocco's Hicham el Guerrouj broke his second world indoor record in 10 days on Wednesday when he claimed the mile mark which had stood for nearly 14 years.
El Guerrouj clocked three minutes 48.45 seconds at the Flanders indoor athletics meeting to beat the 3:49.78 set by Ireland's Eamonn Coghlan on February 27 1983 in East Rutherford, New Jersey.
He also broke the 1,500 metres mark of Noureddine Morceli of Algeria by nearly three seconds in Stuttgart, Germany, on February 2.
